goal: Extend the spot-position model from {1,2,3,last} to {1,2,3,4,5,L} with L distinct from the ordinals, make the preferred set configurable per client and per agreement, and make any preferred-position percentage state its counting method.

design.axes: kairos/model/spec.py DEFAULT_BREAK_POSITIONS (first/middle/last) is the position of a BREAK inside a PROGRAMME, the retention model channel grid. It is NOT the trade's position and was left untouched. The trade's position is the position of a SPOT inside a BREAK (position_in_break).
design.resolution_rule: An explicitly priced ordinal wins; L applies when position == break_size and that ordinal is not priced; otherwise default_middle. Ordinals 4 and 5 ship UNSET, which is the no-op.
design.preferred_set: Tri-state, unset everywhere by default. Precedence agreement > client > channel default. No percentage may be computed while unset.
design.counting: AGENCY_METHOD and CHANNEL_METHOD, method is a required argument and is welded to the returned number, bilingually labelled.

proof.golden_note: tests/golden_weekly_schedule.py was ALREADY RED at HEAD before any edit in this task, so its committed constant is stale. Proof of no-change is a live pre-edit hash against a live post-edit hash of the same engine.
proof.position_grid_parity: position_premium matches the previous derived rule for every (position, break_size) over break sizes 1 to 12, asserted in tests/test_positions.py::test_shipped_rate_card_prices_every_slot_exactly_as_before

not_done: No preferred-position percentage is surfaced on any dashboard page. The engine primitive exists and refuses to compute while the preferred set is unset; wiring a real percentage needs a per-campaign appearance feed (traffic log position_in_break plus break size) and an owner decision on which method a channel surface quotes.
Top and Tail (two creatives in one break separated by exactly one or two other ads) is still unmodelled; it is gap 3 of the trade doc, not the position model.
